name: labs/anguyen-23__sila-testing
title: PerkinElmer Opera Phenix (PhenixImager SiLA 2 feature)
intro: PerkinElmer Opera Phenix (PhenixImager SiLA 2 feature), adapted from anguyen-23/sila-testing. It reads `IsConnected`, `DeviceState`, `StagePosition`, `PlateDetected` and 6 more; runs `phenix_connect`, `phenix_disconnect`, `phenix_stagein`, `phenix_stageout` and 5 more. `phenix_connect`: open the RCI connection to the named Phenix host and return the device name. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
